literal: Early in Heqing, he was made guard general.
idiomatic: Early in Heqing he was made guard general.

literal: In the second year he was appointed bearer of the staff of office with extraordinary powers, area commander-in-chief of Eastern Chuzhou military affairs, and governor of Eastern Chuzhou.
idiomatic: In the second year he was appointed bearer of the staff with extraordinary powers, area commander-in-chief of Eastern Chuzhou military affairs, and governor of Eastern Chuzhou.

literal: In the second year of Tian tong he was granted equal in insignia to three masters of ceremonies and made commandant of the guards.
idiomatic: In the second year of Tian tong he was granted equal in insignia to three masters of ceremonies and made commandant of the guards.

literal: In the fourth year he was given opening of a government office and made grand master for splendid happiness of the right.
idiomatic: In the fourth year he was given opening of a government office and grand master for splendid happiness of the right.

literal: He died at the beginning of Wuping.
idiomatic: He died at the beginning of Wuping.

literal: In governing, Yuan favored leniency and harmony and showed grace and kindness.
idiomatic: In governing, Yuan favored leniency and harmony and showed grace and kindness.

literal: When he reached Eastern Chu, that winter the walled town suffered a great fire; townspeople lost their property. Yuan went in person to the rescue, wept before them, and then made arrangements so that all were able to settle and establish themselves.
idiomatic: When he reached Eastern Chu, that winter the walled town suffered a great fire and townspeople lost their property. Yuan went in person to the rescue, wept before them, and then made arrangements so that all were able to settle.

literal: His eldest son Shirong was secretariat secretary and attendant of the yellow gate.
idiomatic: His eldest son Shirong was secretariat secretary and attendant of the yellow gate.

literal: Wang Jun, styled Luansong, was a native of Lingqiu.
idiomatic: Wang Jun, styled Luansong, was a native of Lingqiu.

literal: He was clear-minded and possessed resource and strategy.
idiomatic: He was clear-minded and possessed resource and strategy.

literal: Gao Huan made him ink-office clerk in the chancellor's government; for an offense he was removed from office.
idiomatic: Gao Huan made him ink-office clerk in the chancellor's government; for an offense he was removed from office.

literal: After a long while, when Gao Yang was equal in insignia with an opening office, he was brought in as clerk of the city bureau.
idiomatic: After a long while, when Gao Yang was equal in insignia with an opening office, he was brought in as clerk of the city bureau.

literal: He rose in succession to chief impartial judge of Heng Province and outer-troops clerk in Shizong's chancellor's office.
idiomatic: He rose in succession to chief impartial judge of Heng Province and outer-troops clerk in Gao Cheng's chancellor's office.

literal: Following the armies he pacified Huaiyin and was enfeoffed baron of Beiping county.
idiomatic: Following the armies he pacified Huaiyin and was enfeoffed baron of Beiping county.

literal: He was made governor of Ying Province.
idiomatic: He was made governor of Ying Province.

literal: Ying Province bordered the frontier; bandits repeatedly harmed the people.
idiomatic: Ying Province bordered the frontier, and bandits repeatedly harmed the people.

literal: When Jun reached the province he set distant scouts and broadly deployed decoy troops; whenever bandits appeared he usually struck them from unexpected quarters, and the bandits did not dare stir — the whole circuit was secure.
idiomatic: When Jun reached the province he set distant scouts and broadly deployed decoy troops; whenever bandits appeared he usually struck from unexpected quarters, and the bandits did not dare stir — the whole circuit was secure.

literal: Earlier the governor Lu Shimao had deceptively killed more than eight hundred Shiwei; for this reason their court tribute ceased.
idiomatic: Earlier the governor Lu Shimao had deceptively killed more than eight hundred Shiwei, and for this reason their court tribute ceased.

literal: Now Jun divided his forces and ordered officers and men to lie in wait along their route; the Shiwei indeed came, and he routed them severely, took their chief captive, and returned.
idiomatic: Now Jun divided his forces and ordered officers and men to lie in wait along their route; the Shiwei indeed came, and he routed them severely, took their chief captive, and returned.

literal: He then treated them with thick favor and ritual and sent them away.
idiomatic: He then treated them with thick favor and ritual and sent them away.

literal: The Shiwei thereupon offered sincere allegiance and tribute without cease; Jun had much to do with it.
idiomatic: The Shiwei thereupon offered sincere allegiance and tribute without cease; Jun had much to do with it.

literal: Earlier the Rouran lord Anluochen had led his remaining followers east in migration; Jun reckoned he would certainly come and prepared in advance.
idiomatic: Earlier the Rouran lord Anluochen had led his remaining followers east in migration; Jun reckoned he would certainly come and prepared in advance.

literal: Before long Anluochen arrived and encamped his army west of the city.
idiomatic: Before long Anluochen arrived and encamped his army west of the city.

literal: Jun then set an ambush and routed them greatly, capturing their famous king Yujiulü Doubati and several tens of others, and sent them to the capital.
idiomatic: Jun then set an ambush and routed them greatly, capturing their famous king Yujiulü Doubati and several tens of others, and sent them to the capital.

literal: Anluochen thereupon fled away.
idiomatic: Anluochen thereupon fled away.

literal: The emperor greatly praised him.
idiomatic: The emperor greatly praised him.

literal: He was transferred to director of the secretariat.
idiomatic: He was transferred to director of the secretariat.

literal: When the deposed emperor took the throne he was made governor of Luo Province and left aide of the Heyang circuit traveling staff.
idiomatic: When the deposed emperor took the throne he was made governor of Luo Province and left aide of the Heyang circuit traveling staff.

literal: In Huangjian an edict ordered that along the western border of Luo Province a long moat three hundred li be dug and garrison posts set to guard against spies.
idiomatic: In Huangjian an edict ordered that along the western border of Luo Province a long moat three hundred li be dug and garrison posts set to guard against spies.

literal: In the first year of Heqing he was summoned and appointed minister of the imperial clan.
idiomatic: In the first year of Heqing he was summoned and appointed minister of the imperial clan.

literal: An edict ordered him to go to Jinyang to inspect troops and horses; soon he returned to Ye and was transferred to grand master of the stud.
idiomatic: An edict ordered him to go to Jinyang to inspect troops and horses; soon he returned to Ye and was transferred to grand master of the stud.

literal: Whenever the imperial carriage went on tour he constantly assisted the heir apparent and the princes of royal blood together with Minister of the Civil Office Wei Jin in managing affairs behind the scenes.
idiomatic: Whenever the imperial carriage went on tour he constantly assisted the heir apparent and the princes of royal blood together with Minister of the Civil Office Wei Jin in managing affairs behind the scenes.

literal: He was also granted dry rations of Liang commandery and promoted to palace attendant and made minister of justice.
idiomatic: He was also granted dry rations of Liang commandery, promoted to palace attendant, and made minister of justice.

literal: When Zhou armies pressed the border, an edict ordered Jun, in his existing office, together with the Prince of Dong'an Lou Rui, the Prince of Wuxing Pu, and others to lead troops from Ye to Heyang to resist them.
idiomatic: When Zhou armies pressed the border, an edict ordered Jun, in his existing office, together with the Prince of Dong'an Lou Rui, the Prince of Wuxing Pu, and others to lead troops from Ye to Heyang to resist them.

literal: The imperial carriage went to Luoyang; because Xuanhuo had been taken by the Zhou, Jun was again ordered as traveling staff on the southern route with Lou Rui to lead troops south in campaign.
idiomatic: The imperial carriage went to Luoyang; because Xuanhuo had been taken by the Zhou, Jun was again ordered as traveling staff on the southern route with Lou Rui to lead troops south in campaign.

literal: Before they arrived the Zhou armies abandoned the city and fled; he was then sent to comfort and settle Yong and Ying provinces.
idiomatic: Before they arrived the Zhou armies abandoned the city and fled; he was then sent to comfort and settle Yong and Ying provinces.

literal: In the spring of the fourth year he returned to the capital.
idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year he returned to the capital.

literal: He sat convicted of violating regulations by privately importing banned goods and stealing and intercepting army grain; the authorities by regulation sentenced him to decapitation and his household to confiscation.
idiomatic: He was convicted of violating regulations by privately importing banned goods and stealing and intercepting army grain; the authorities by regulation sentenced him to decapitation and his household to confiscation.

literal: By special edict the sentence was decided as one hundred strokes of the whip; his name was struck from the rolls and he was assigned to the armorers' ward; his household was exempted.
idiomatic: By special edict the sentence was decided as one hundred strokes of the whip; his name was struck from the rolls and he was assigned to the armorers' ward, and his household was exempted.

literal: When an amnesty came he was pardoned and ceased to be confined at his private gate.
idiomatic: When an amnesty came he was pardoned and ceased to be confined at his private gate.

literal: In the second year of Tian tong he was made general of chariots and cavalry on the rapid and equal in insignia to three masters of ceremonies; soon he was given opening of a government office.
idiomatic: In the second year of Tian tong he was made general of chariots and cavalry on the rapid and equal in insignia to three masters of ceremonies; soon he was given opening of a government office.

literal: At the beginning of Wuping he was made palace attendant.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Wuping he was made palace attendant.

literal: In the fourth year he died.
idiomatic: In the fourth year he died.

literal: Posthumously granted the dignity of duke of works.
idiomatic: Posthumously granted the dignity of duke of works.

literal: Wang Hong, styled Shiluo, was a native of Dina in Tai'an and was chief of a minor tribal division.
idiomatic: Wang Hong, styled Shiluo, was a native of Dina in Tai'an and was chief of a minor tribal division.

literal: His father Ji was well read and possessed wisdom and strategy.
idiomatic: His father Ji was well read and possessed wisdom and strategy.

literal: At first he followed Ge Rong in rebellion; Ge Rong made Ji Prince of Jibei and governor of Ningzhou.
idiomatic: At first he followed Ge Rong in rebellion; Ge Rong made Ji Prince of Jibei and governor of Ning Province.

literal: Later, when Ge Rong was defeated, Ji held the city and would not submit; Erzhu Rong sent envoys to instruct him, and only then did he surrender.
idiomatic: Later, when Ge Rong was defeated, Ji held the city and would not submit; Erzhu Rong sent envoys to instruct him, and only then did he surrender.

literal: Rong later made him staff attendant and ordered him to lead troops to garrison Mochuan.
idiomatic: Rong later made him staff attendant and ordered him to lead troops to garrison Mochuan.

literal: When Rong died, Hedouling Bufan took Ji captive to Hexi; later he escaped and returned to Erzhu Zhao.
idiomatic: When Rong died, Hedouling Bufan took Ji captive to Hexi; later he escaped and returned to Erzhu Zhao.

literal: When Gao Huan pacified Zhao, Ji was made area commander and governor of Yining.
idiomatic: When Gao Huan pacified Zhao, Ji was made area commander and governor of Yining.

literal: Ji had earlier known Zhou Wendi while in Ge Rong's army; when Wendi held Guanzhong, Gao Huan sent Ji with chief clerk Hou Jing on a mission to Zhou Wendi, and Wendi detained Ji and would not send him back.
idiomatic: Ji had earlier known Zhou Wendi while in Ge Rong's army; when Wendi held Guanzhong, Gao Huan sent Ji with chief clerk Hou Jing on a mission to Zhou Wendi, and Wendi detained Ji and would not send him back.

literal: Ji later escaped and returned; he was made chief clerk of Ji Province, then acting administrator of Si Province.
idiomatic: Ji later escaped and returned; he was made chief clerk of Ji Province, then acting administrator of Si Province.

literal: At the beginning of Yuanxiang he rose in succession to governor of Southern Yi and Northern Yu provinces.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Yuanxiang he rose in succession to governor of Southern Yi and Northern Yu provinces.

literal: In every post he loved to extort and gather wealth, yet his nature was upright and straightforward, and officials and commoners did not greatly resent him.
idiomatic: In every post he loved to extort and gather wealth, yet his nature was upright and straightforward, and officials and commoners did not greatly resent him.

literal: In the fourth year of Xinghe, in winter, he was killed by a slave; he was sixty-five.
idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xinghe, in winter, he was killed by a slave; he was sixty-five.

literal: Posthumously granted general who campaigns east, minister of the civil office, and governor of Ding Province.
idiomatic: Posthumously granted general who campaigns east, minister of the civil office, and governor of Ding Province.

literal: Hong from youth loved bow and horse and was skilled in mounted archery; he also delighted in letters.
idiomatic: Hong from youth loved bow and horse and was skilled in mounted archery; he also delighted in letters.

literal: His nature was sharp and quick, and his replies came readily.
idiomatic: His nature was sharp and quick, and his replies came readily.

literal: At thirteen he met Guo Yuanzhen of Taiyuan, governor of Yang Province; Yuanzhen stroked his back and said, "What books do you read?"
idiomatic: At thirteen he met Guo Yuanzhen of Taiyuan, governor of Yang Province; Yuanzhen stroked his back and said, "What books do you read?"

literal: He replied, "I recite the Classic of Filial Piety."
idiomatic: He replied, "I recite the Classic of Filial Piety."

literal: He said, "What does the Classic of Filial Piety say?"
idiomatic: He said, "What does the Classic of Filial Piety say?"

literal: He said, "He who is above is not arrogant; he who is below does not rebel."
idiomatic: He said, "He who is above is not arrogant; he who is below does not rebel."

literal: Yuanzhen said, "I serve as governor — am I arrogant?"
idiomatic: Yuanzhen said, "I serve as governor — am I arrogant?"

literal: Hong said, "Though you are not arrogant, a gentleman guards against what has not yet sprouted; I too hope you will take note."
idiomatic: Hong said, "Though you are not arrogant, a gentleman guards against what has not yet sprouted; I too hope you will take note."

literal: Yuanzhen praised him.
idiomatic: Yuanzhen praised him.

literal: At fifteen he followed his father in Northern Yu Province; the traveling staff's Hou Jing debated with others whether the lapel should be right or left.
idiomatic: At fifteen he followed his father in Northern Yu Province; the traveling staff's Hou Jing debated with others whether the lapel should be right or left.

literal: Minister Jing Xianjun said, "Confucius said, 'Were it not for Guan Zhong, we would wear our hair loose and our lapel to the left.' By this reasoning the right lapel is correct."
idiomatic: Minister Jing Xianjun said, "Confucius said, 'Were it not for Guan Zhong, we would wear our hair loose and our lapel to the left.' By this reasoning the right lapel is correct."

literal: Hong advanced and said, "Our state rose like a dragon in the northern wilds and strides heroically through the Central Plain; the Five Emperors had different institutions and the Three Kings different systems — whether the lapel is left or right is hardly worth arguing over."
idiomatic: Hong advanced and said, "Our state rose like a dragon in the northern wilds and strides heroically through the Central Plain; the Five Emperors had different institutions and the Three Kings different systems — whether the lapel is left or right is hardly worth arguing over."

literal: Jing marveled at his early brilliance and bestowed a famous horse on him.
idiomatic: Jing marveled at his early brilliance and bestowed a famous horse on him.

literal: In Xinghe Zhong, Shizong summoned him as vault attendant and made him court gentleman attendant.
idiomatic: In Xinghe Zhong, Gao Cheng summoned him as vault attendant and made him court gentleman attendant.

literal: When Shizong died suddenly, Hong braved blades to ward off attack and for loyal fidelity was granted the rank baron of Pingchun county, given seven hundred bolts of cloth, fifty bolts of damask silk, thirty thousand cash, and a gold belt and fine horse, and was made magistrate of Jinyang.
idiomatic: When Gao Cheng died suddenly, Hong braved blades to ward off attack and for loyal fidelity was granted the rank baron of Pingchun county, given seven hundred bolts of cloth, fifty bolts of damask silk, thirty thousand cash, and a gold belt and fine horse, and was made magistrate of Jinyang.

literal: At the beginning of Tianbao he was made general who pacifies the distant and was much known and favored by Gao Yang.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianbao he was made general who pacifies the distant and was much known and favored by Gao Yang.

literal: Once when the emperor was drinking with his attendants he said, "How great the joy!"
idiomatic: Once when the emperor was drinking with his attendants he said, "How great the joy!"

literal: Hong replied, "There is also great joy and great bitterness."
idiomatic: Hong replied, "There is also great joy and great bitterness."

literal: The emperor said, "What is great bitterness?"
idiomatic: The emperor said, "What is great bitterness?"

literal: Hong said, "Long nights of reckless drinking without waking — ruined state and shattered house, body dead and name extinguished: that is what is called great bitterness."
idiomatic: Hong said, "Long nights of reckless drinking without waking — ruined state and shattered house, body dead and name extinguished: that is what is called great bitterness."

literal: The emperor fell silent.
idiomatic: The emperor fell silent.

literal: Later he reproached Hong: "You served my brother together with Hexi Shele; when Shele died, why did you not die?"
idiomatic: Later he reproached Hong: "You served my brother together with Hexi Shele; when Shele died, why did you not die?"

literal: Hong said, "When the lord perishes the minister dies — that is the constant rule; but the rebel brutes' blows were weak and their cuts light, so your servant did not die."
idiomatic: Hong said, "When the lord perishes the minister dies — that is the constant rule; but the rebel brutes' blows were weak and their cuts light, so your servant did not die."

literal: The emperor had Yan Zixian bind Hong in reverse, the Prince of Changgang seized his head, and the emperor was about to strike with his blade; Hong said, "Yang Zunyian and Cui Jishu fled to avoid disaster yet rose to vice director and minister; men who risked death in loyal service are instead slaughtered — never in antiquity was there such a thing."
idiomatic: The emperor had Yan Zixian bind Hong in reverse, the Prince of Changgang seized his head, and the emperor was about to strike with his blade; Hong said, "Yang Zunyian and Cui Jishu fled to avoid disaster yet rose to vice director and minister; men who risked death in loyal service are instead slaughtered — never in antiquity was there such a thing."

literal: The emperor cast his blade to the ground and said, "Wang Shiluo must not be killed."
idiomatic: The emperor cast his blade to the ground and said, "Wang Shiluo must not be killed."

literal: Thereupon he spared him.
idiomatic: Thereupon he spared him.

literal: At the beginning of Wuping he was opening office, equal in insignia to three masters of ceremonies.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Wuping he was opening office, equal in insignia to three masters of ceremonies.

literal: Hong submitted a memorial: "The Turks and the Yuwen clan exchange their sons and daughters in marriage and will surely act in concert; they will raid the borders north and south."
idiomatic: Hong submitted a memorial: "The Turks and the Yuwen clan exchange sons and daughters in marriage and will surely act in concert; they will raid the borders north and south."

literal: "Choose the strongest crossbowmen from the nine provinces and place them in many critical passes."
idiomatic: "Choose the strongest crossbowmen from the nine provinces and place them at many critical passes."

literal: "I venture to hope Your Majesty will pity the loyal and remember the old, cherish the orphaned and comfort the widowed, pity the foolish and praise the good, pardon faults and record merit, thicken kinship among flesh and bone, broaden the path of generous forbearance, think of the manner of Yao and Shun, admire the virtue of Yu and Tang, restrain yourself and return to ritual, to complete a transformation of culture — all under Heaven would be greatly blessed."
idiomatic: "I venture to hope Your Majesty will pity the loyal and remember the old, cherish the orphaned and comfort the widowed, pity the foolish and praise the good, pardon faults and record merit, thicken kinship among flesh and bone, broaden the path of generous forbearance, think of the manner of Yao and Shun, admire the virtue of Yu and Tang, restrain yourself and return to ritual to complete a transformation of culture — all under Heaven would be greatly blessed."

literal: In the fifth year Chen troops raided Huainan; an edict ordered the officials collectively to discuss defense.
idiomatic: In the fifth year Chen troops raided Huainan; an edict ordered the officials collectively to discuss defense.

literal: Feng Fuxiang asked to go out and strike.
idiomatic: Feng Fuxiang asked to go out and strike.

literal: Hong said, "Our armies have repeatedly met defeat; popular feeling is unsettled. If we again raise troops to the utmost and march out to camp on the Huai and Jiang, I fear the northern Di will raid from the west and, seizing our weakness, come with the whole realm — then the cause is lost."
idiomatic: Hong said, "Our armies have repeatedly met defeat and popular feeling is unsettled. If we again raise troops to the utmost and march out to camp on the Huai and Jiang, I fear the northern Di will raid from the west and, seizing our weakness, come with the whole realm — then the cause is lost."

literal: "Better to lighten taxes and reduce corvée, rest the people and nurture the shi, so that court and regions are harmonious and the distant and near turn their hearts; campaign with benevolence and righteousness and rouse them with virtue — all under Heaven will be swept clear, not only false Chen!"
idiomatic: "Better to lighten taxes and reduce corvée, rest the people and nurture the shi, so that court and regions are harmonious and the distant and near turn their hearts; campaign with benevolence and righteousness and rouse them with virtue — all under Heaven will be swept clear, not only false Chen!"

literal: Gao Anagong said to the assembly, "Those who follow the palace guard on the south take the south seats."
idiomatic: Gao Anagong said to the assembly, "Those who follow the palace guard on the south take the south seats."

literal: The assembly all agreed.
idiomatic: The assembly all agreed.

literal: Soon he was concurrently palace attendant and went on mission to Zhou.
idiomatic: Soon he was concurrently palace attendant and went on mission to Zhou.

literal: When the mission returned he was immediately confirmed in office; before long he died.
idiomatic: When the mission returned he was immediately confirmed in office; before long he died.

literal: Hong loved to write; he composed twenty-four chapters of "Mirrors and Warnings," with considerable literary meaning.
idiomatic: Hong loved to write; he composed twenty-four chapters of "Mirrors and Warnings," with considerable literary meaning.

literal: The historiographer says: Zhang Zuan and the others all pressed to serve the hegemonic court, displaying their achievements — all were good ministers of Qi.
idiomatic: The historiographer says: Zhang Zuan and the others all hurried to serve the hegemonic court and display their merit — all were worthy ministers of Qi.

literal: Bode's wailing over the corpse, Lingguang's holding the pass and halting the carriage — therein was the manner of the ancients.
idiomatic: Bode's wailing over the corpse, Lingguang's holding the pass and halting the carriage — therein was the manner of the ancients.

literal: Praise says: Zuan, Liang, Yao, Qi, Xu Yuan, Hong, Jun — they rose with the sun, shook the wind from afar.
idiomatic: Praise says: Zuan, Liang, Yao, Qi, Xu Yuan, Hong, Jun — they rose with the sun and shook the wind from afar.

literal: Tree dead, holding the pass — to the end, bright in faith and obedience.
idiomatic: When Shizong died, he barred the gate — to the end, bright in faith and obedience.
